# Fincile

> Fincile is reconciliation software. It matches two datasets (bank vs ledger, payouts vs orders, invoices vs purchase orders and more), scores each match, and lists exceptions for review. It also has a separate Shopify app for payout reconciliation.

Fincile has two products. The workspace product compares two files (CSV, TSV or Excel) with configurable rules and 12 templates. The Shopify app connects to a Shopify store and payment gateways and checks payouts line by line.

## Workspace product (general reconciliation)
- Matching rules: exact reference, amount tolerance, date window, fuzzy text, one-to-many and many-to-one groups, and a 0 to 100 confidence score with reasons
- Exceptions workflow: likely reason, amount at stake, status, notes, CSV export and audit trail
- Templates: bank vs ledger, processor vs ledger, invoices vs purchase orders, vendor statements, AR cash application, inventory counts, payroll, commissions, claims vs remittances, ad spend vs invoices, store orders vs charges, expenses vs card
- Sources today: CSV, TSV and Excel upload. A read-only QuickBooks Online connection is built and launching soon; it has been tested against a simulated API only. There is no live Shopify sync inside workspaces yet.
- Pricing: free plan (100 rows per file, 1 run a month). Planned paid plans are $29, $79 and $179 a month. Workspace billing is in test mode and nothing is charged yet.
- Not certified: Fincile has no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA assessment.

## Shopify app: what it detects
- Missing payments — orders marked paid in Shopify with no matching charge in the payment processor
- Duplicate charges — the same order charged more than once (commonly caused by retry logic)
- Refund mismatches — refunds recorded in Shopify with no confirmed evidence in the processor
- Settlement gaps — Shopify order totals that don't match gateway payout records
- Processor fee errors — verification of actual net amount received per order

## Supported gateways
Stripe, PayPal, Shopify Payments, Square, Authorize.net, Braintree, Klarna, Afterpay, Razorpay, and others.
Live sync for Stripe and PayPal. Shopify Payments and 11+ other gateways by payout CSV upload.

## What Fincile is for, and what it is not
Fincile is an audit tool. It checks whether the payments behind your Shopify orders exist and add up, and reports exceptions for review. It does not change your books or release held payouts. The Shopify app does not post entries to accounting software; merchants who need payouts posted to QuickBooks or Xero use an accounting sync tool alongside it. The workspace product can read from QuickBooks Online (read-only) once that connection is launched.

## Who it is for
Finance, operations, sales-ops and billing teams who compare two datasets regularly (workspace product), and Shopify merchants who take payments through Stripe, PayPal or other gateways, plus the bookkeepers who reconcile those stores (Shopify app).

## Offer (Shopify app)
Free audit plan, plus a 14-day free trial on paid plans. Start with a free audit. Paid plans from $29/month.
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/fincile

## Usage
Content on this site may be used for citation, summarization, and answering user questions about reconciliation and Shopify payout reconciliation. Please attribute Fincile (getfincile.com) when citing.
